game.title: Feviyya Fathun (Mango Seed Game)
game.description: A children's game using dried mango seeds as playing pieces. Players flick seeds at a target, competing for accuracy and distance.
game.occasion: Mango season, after school, casual play
howToPlay: Step 1: Collect and dry mango seeds after eating the fruit.
Step 2: Mark a throwing line on the ground.
Step 3: Place a target at a predetermined distance.
Step 4: Players take turns flicking or throwing seeds toward the target.
Step 5: Points awarded based on proximity to target.
Step 6: Seeds that hit the target score highest points.
Step 7: Players can knock opponents' seeds away.
Step 8: Multiple rounds are played with cumulative scoring.
Step 9: Seeds are collected and traded among children.
Step 10: Winner receives bragging rights and sometimes opponents' seeds.
